name: ClinuxFlowFacility
title: ClinuxFlow Facility
description: A clinic/hospital facility, profiling FHIR R4 Organization. Element cardinalities and required-ness are grounded directly against the real Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission Health Facility Registry (HFR) Basic/Additional Information APIs (docs/NHPR SBX Doc/NHPR Doc/HFR/New_HFR_APIs_Documentation_SBX.pdf) — not reverse-engineered from this app's own prior YAML, which had drifted (e.g. Organization.telecom.value used for phone/whatsapp/email/website with no differentiation at all). Fields the HFR API marks Required map to min:1 here; HFR-optional fields stay min:0. Real FHIR base cardinalities are narrowed, never widened, and every narrowing is a deliberate call, noted inline.

element.comment: HFR Basic Information API: facilityName, Required.

element.short: Legal/trade name, if different from the display name
Whether the facility is currently operational
element.comment: HFR: facilityOperationalStatus, Required, a real boolean concept (Functional vs. not) — a Dropdown-with-string-choices capture of this was a real, live-found bug in the prior YAML (produced active:"Functional" instead of active:true). Must be captured as an actual boolean.

HFR Basic Information API: facilityTypeCode, Required — accepted codes per HFR's own fetch-facility-type master API. Narrowed from base FHIR's 0..* to 1..1: a facility has exactly one primary HFR type, not a set.

Server-assigned by HFR only AFTER the on-boarding API sequence completes (Basic -> Additional -> Detailed -> Submit) — genuinely absent for a facility still in Draft/Submitted status, hence min:0 even though it's the facility's real primary business identifier once assigned. HFR's own tracking ID (used before a real facilityId exists) is carried separately, not as an Organization.identifier.

Sliced by system+use — the real, standard FHIR fix for the prior YAML's 4-way Organization.telecom.value collision (phone/whatsapp/email/website all landing on the same leaf with no way to tell them apart except array position).
HFR: facilityContactNumber, valid 10-digit mobile number.
HFR: facilityLandlineNumber + facilityStdCode, both optional, 6-8 digit landline.
HFR: facilityEmailId, optional.
HFR: websiteLink, optional, must be a valid URL.

Deliberately narrowed from base FHIR Organization.address's real 0..* — this profile treats a facility as having exactly one primary registered address (HFR itself has no concept of a facility with multiple registered addresses); a multi-branch clinic models each branch as its own Organization/Location, not multiple addresses on one Organization.
HFR: addressLine1 (Required, min length 5) + addressLine2 (optional).
HFR: country, Required, "By Default its India" — a real fixed value per the spec, not an assumption.
HFR: pincode, Required, 6-digit.
HFR: stateLGDCode, Required. No standard FHIR address element carries an LGD code — a real extension is the correct FHIR answer, not a repurposed Address.state string.
HFR: districtLGDCode, Required.
HFR: subDistrictLGDCode, Required.
HFR: villageCityTownLGDCode, Optional.

HFR: facilityRegion (R/U — Rural/Urban), Optional. get-master-data type='FACILITY-REGION' — real master data, not a locally-invented 2-choice (found and fixed live: this field was first built from the doc's own worked sample alone, which happened to only show R/U, before checking whether it was ALSO a real master-data type).

HFR Basic Information API: typeOfServiceCode, "Yes, based on the facility type provided" — conditionally required (not needed at all for several facility types per the doc's own exclusion list, e.g. Diagnostic Laboratory/Imaging Center/Pharmacy), modeled here as min:0 rather than a FHIRPath conditional-required invariant this profile doesn't otherwise use elsewhere. get-master-data type='TYPE-SERVICE'.

HFR Basic Information API: specialityTypeCode, "Yes, based on the facility type provided" — same real conditional-requiredness as typeOfServiceCode above, min:0 for the same reason. get-master-data type='SPECIALITY-TYPE' (real codes SINGLE/MULTI — a real bug found and fixed live: this app's own capture UI first hardcoded 'MULTIPLE', which isn't a real HFR code at all).

HFR Basic Information API: ownershipSubTypeCode2 — present in the API's own real worked sample alongside ownershipSubTypeCode above (a genuinely SECOND, distinct sub-type code), but not documented in the API's own parameter table as separately required, hence min:0. Deliberately no `binding` here: this is really two sub-fields in one — a PROFIT-vs-NON-PROFIT category choice (not itself an ABDM master-data type, a real fixed 2-way domain split) selecting which of PROFIT-TYPE/NON-PROFIT-TYPE's real master-data ValueSet applies to the code actually stored — modeled as a real client-side cascading choice (see FacilityHfrPanel.vue) rather than one static binding, the same way this profile already treats State/District/SubDistrict LGD codes as a cascade rather than one flat ValueSet.

HFR: latitude, Required, -90.000000 to +90.000000. FHIR's Location.position exists for exactly this on a Location resource; kept as an extension here because this element belongs to the facility's own Organization-level registration payload, not a separate Location instance in this profile's scope.
HFR: longitude, Required, -180.000000 to +180.000000.
HFR: ownershipCode, Required (get-master-data type='OWNER').
HFR: ownershipSubTypeCode, Required (get-owner-subtype API).
HFR: facilitySubType, Required (fetch-facility-sub-type API, keyed off facilityTypeCode).

HFR: systemOfMedicineCode, Required, real multi-value ("a comma separated string of codes" per the API doc when a facility offers more than one) — modeled here as a real repeating extension, not a single comma-joined string. get-master-data type='MEDICINE' — 9 real codes (UN/M/YN/SR/A/SD/H/P/D); a real gap found live while grounding this: this profile's own capture UI never actually rendered a field for this element at all after AbdmOnboarding.vue's LForms rendering was retired, and the prior hand-picked 7-choice label list (missing Physiotherapy and Sowa-Rigpa, and stored labels, not the real wire codes) predates this binding.

HFR's own coded operational-status value (get-master-data type='FAC-STATUS') — kept distinct from Organization.active above: active is the derived real FHIR boolean this profile requires for internal use (and fixes the historical Dropdown-as-string bug), this extension carries HFR's own richer status code (e.g. beyond just functional/non-functional) for round-tripping to the real HFR API untouched.
HFR's own trackingId — the facility's temporary handle before a real facilityId is assigned (see Organization.identifier:hfrFacilityId's own comment). Present only pre-submission.

HFR Additional Information API: hasDialysisCenter. Real bug found and fixed: NOT a plain Y/N boolean — get-master-data type='GENERAL-INFO-OPTIONS' has 3 real codes (YALL/YIN/N), confirmed against the doc's own worked sample.
HFR Additional Information API: hasPharmacy. Gates whether Detailed Information's pharmacyDetails section is required.
HFR Additional Information API: hasBloodBank. Gates whether Detailed Information's bloodBankDetails section is required.
HFR Additional Information API: hasCathLab.
HFR Additional Information API: hasDiagnosticLab. Gates whether Detailed Information's diagnosticServices section is required.
HFR Additional Information API: hasImagingCenter. Gates whether Detailed Information's imagingServices section is required.
HFR Detailed Information API: pharmacyDetails.isJanAushadhiKendra — required only when hasPharmacy is YALL/YIN.
HFR Detailed Information API: pharmacyDetails.janAushadhiKendraId — required only if isJanAushadhiKendra is Y.
HFR Detailed Information API: pharmacyDetails.drugLicenseNumber — required when hasPharmacy is YALL/YIN.
HFR Detailed Information API: pharmacyDetails.pharmacyGstinNumber, Optional.
HFR Detailed Information API: pharmacyDetails.pharmacistRegistrationNumber, Optional.
HFR Detailed Information API: bloodBankDetails.isFacilityRegisteredInERaktkosh — required when hasBloodBank is YALL/YIN.
HFR Detailed Information API: bloodBankDetails.eRaktoshId — required if registered in e-Raktkosh.
HFR Detailed Information API: bloodBankDetails.bloodBankLicenseNumber — required when hasBloodBank is YALL/YIN.

HFR Detailed Information API: imagingServices[].service — required (List) when hasImagingCenter is YALL/YIN, one entry per service offered (equipment count sent as 1 per entry, not separately captured here).
HFR Detailed Information API: diagnosticServices — required (comma-separated codes) when hasDiagnosticLab is YALL/YIN.

HFR Detailed Information API: medicalInfrastructure.totalNumberOfBeds — required, based on facility type, must be >= the sum of the individual bed-count fields this profile does not separately capture (IPD/ICU/HDU/daycare beds each with/without oxygen or ventilators).
HFR Detailed Information API: medicalInfrastructure.countDentalChairs, Optional (mandatory in practice only when Dentistry is among the facility's systemOfMedicine — not separately gated here).
